text: Dalia is brought to Mars after her unusual technical gifts attract attention. Koriel Zeth protects her and gives her a place in the project to construct the Akashic reader.

As Mars descends into civil war, Dalia’s work becomes part of a much larger struggle over knowledge and belief. Her journey takes her beneath the planet, where she encounters the Dragon and the duty of its guardianship.
She accepts a responsibility defined by containment and secrecy rather than the unrestricted revelation she first sought through the reader.
